name: Adyen

webhook.algorithm: CRITICAL DEVIATION — Adyen does NOT sign the raw body for standard payment webhooks. HMAC-SHA256, Base64-encoded, placed in the JSON at `notificationItems[].NotificationRequestItem.additionalData.hmacSignature`, computed over a COLON-delimited concatenation of a field subset: pspReference:originalReference:merchantAccountCode:merchantReference:value:currency:eventCode:success (empty fields become empty strings; `:` and `\` inside values are backslash-escaped). The HMAC key is hex and must be decoded to binary before use. Non-payment webhooks (Management, Transfer, Report, Balance Platform) ins

credentials.note: Auth header is `X-API-Key` (API key generated per merchant/company account); Adyen keys have no documented stable public prefix regex — UNKNOWN, do not emit a regex. Basic auth (ws user) exists for legacy/classic platforms. Checkout API cur

onboarding.note: Enterprise sales process with volume expectations. Not open to an individual or a small seller.

fees.notes: Interchange++ model, verified on adyen.com/pricing: fixed processing fee $0.13 per transaction PLUS a payment-method fee. Visa/Mastercard: $0.13 + Interchange+ + 0.60%. iDEAL: $0.13 + €0.22. SEPA Direct Debit: $0.13 + €0.27. Klarna varies by market (e.g. NL 2.99% + €0.49, FI 0.99% + €0.59). No monthly/setup/closure fees but there IS an undisclosed minimum monthly invoice — this is why Adyen is wrong for small merchants.

notes: The only single integration in this cluster that reaches Wero, TWINT, Swish, Vipps/MobilePay, Satispay, Multibanco and MB WAY at once, and the default for any EU merchant above roughly €1M/yr. Also an acquirer, so it removes the acquirer/gateway split that Redsys, Worldline and Nexi force.

SDKs: Official libraries in node (@adyen/api-library), python (Adyen), php (adyen/adyen-php-api-library), java, .NET, Go, Ruby. All include HMAC validator helpers — the generator should call the library validator, not hand-roll the colon-concatenation.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps stripe at the top end; replaces the need for separate Worldline/Nexi/Datatrans/Swish/Vipps integrations.
Onboarding: sales_gated. Enterprise sales process with volume expectations. Not open to an individual or a small seller.
